# M2: NeuroLab

Branch `feat/m2-neurolab`, worktree `../nt-m2`. Read `STATUS.md` first. **No API or database
changes in this milestone.** Everything is TypeScript, content and UI.

## Goal

NeuroLab makes the neuroscience of reward and addiction something you can explore:
- A 3D brain explorer.
- Region pages built on verified references.
- An interactive reward-learning simulator built on established models.

All of it is educational. The models are abstract learning models and **never claim to simulate
dopamine concentrations**.

### Reward-learning simulator (`/neuro/reward-learning`)
- [x] `src/lib/models/rescorla-wagner.ts`: `ΔV = αβ(λ − V)`, with cue salience α, learning rate
      β, and reward magnitude λ (0 during extinction trials). Inputs: trials, acquisition and
      extinction phases, and an optional reward probability with a seeded PRNG (mulberry32), so
      results are deterministic.
- [x] `src/lib/models/td-learning.ts`: TD(0) over a short trial (cue → delay steps → reward).
      Return the value per state and the prediction error δ per trial. Show the textbook result:
      δ moves from reward time to cue time as learning proceeds.
- [x] Add a "stress" parameter, documented clearly as a **hypothetical modulation** (for example,
      scaling reward sensitivity or learning rate). Label it as such in the UI and the model
      card. It must not be presented as an empirical relationship.
- [x] Jest tests:
  - Rescorla-Wagner converges to λ.
  - α or β = 0 means no learning.
  - Extinction decays V towards 0.
  - Seeded runs are deterministic.
  - In TD, δ at the cue grows and δ at the reward shrinks over trials.
  - Inputs are validated (clamped, or rejected by a zod schema).
- [x] UI:
  - Sliders, presets ("acquisition", "extinction", "partial reinforcement") and an explainer.
  - Recharts for V over trials and δ over trials.
  - A TD heat-strip or line chart that shows δ shifting.
  - Recompute in the browser instantly; no server round-trip.
- [x] Saving a run to `experiments` (module `neuro`) is optional, through a Server Action that
      uses `src/lib/experiments.ts`.

## Notes

**Built**
- `src/lib/content/brain-regions.ts`: six regions with sourced copy and 2–3 Crossref-verified
  references each (DOI + PMID), plus `regionSummary` and `explorerPositions` helpers (tested).
- `/neuro`: React Three Fiber explorer (`brain-canvas.tsx`, loaded with `next/dynamic`,
  `ssr: false`) built from primitives only: translucent hemispheres, cerebellum and brainstem,
  six glowing selectable regions (bilateral regions are mirrored into both hemispheres),
  OrbitControls, hover labels, click-to-select side panel with summary and link. No
  auto-rotate (and an on-demand frame loop) under `prefers-reduced-motion`. A keyboard region
  list (buttons with `aria-pressed`) drives the same selection; the `<canvas>` gets
  `role="img"` and an `aria-label`. If WebGL is unavailable only the list and panel are shown;
  an error boundary covers a scene that fails at runtime. Checked visually in headless Chromium
  at 1400 px and 390 px.
- `/neuro/regions/[slug]`: `generateStaticParams`, every field, DOI and PubMed links,
  `notFound()` for unknown slugs, previous/next navigation.
- `/neuro/reward-learning`: Rescorla-Wagner and TD(0) labs computed in the browser, presets,
  sliders, explainer, Recharts V/error/δ charts, an SVG δ heat-strip, a shared stress control
  labelled "hypothetical modulation", and an optional Server Action that re-validates the
  parameters with zod, recomputes server-side and saves to `experiments` (module `neuro`).
- Model cards `docs/models/rescorla-wagner.md` and `docs/models/td-learning.md`. New DOIs
  (Sutton 1988; Schultz, Dayan & Montague 1997; Miller, Barnet & Grahame 1995) resolved through
  Crossref and PMIDs through E-utilities on 2026-11-19. Rescorla & Wagner 1972 is cited as a book
  chapter without a DOI.
- `e2e/neurolab.spec.ts` (not run, per the rules).

**Deviations**
- Region pages use `generateStaticParams`, but the `(app)` layout calls `requireUser()` (cookies),
  so Next still renders them on demand (ƒ in the build output). Making them truly static would
  mean moving them out of the authenticated layout, which is outside this brief.
- The explorer panel summary is the first sentence of each region's reward-and-learning text
  rather than a separate hand-written summary field, so no unsourced copy was added.
- No dependencies added. `next dev` auto-appends a block to `AGENTS.md`; that change was reverted
  and not committed.

**Left unchecked:** nothing.

### Review

Independent review on 2026-11-19 of `origin/main...HEAD` (feat/test/docs neuro commits).

**Verified**
- Models: `rescorla-wagner.ts` implements ΔV = αβ(λ − V) with λ = 0 on unrewarded and extinction
  trials and seeded mulberry32 draws only on acquisition trials. `td-learning.ts` implements
  TD(0) with δ(t) = r(t) + γV(t) − V(t−1), V(−1) = V(D) = 0, a complete-serial-compound state
  per step, and converges to V(t) = γ^(D−1−t)·r, so δ at reward → 0 and δ at cue → γ^D·r. Tests
  cover convergence, α/β = 0, extinction, determinism, the δ shift (monotone) and zod rejection.
  Stress is a bounded multiplier (1 − 0.5·s), labelled "hypothetical modulation" in the UI,
  the page disclaimer, `stress.ts` and both model cards.
- Server Action: checks `getSessionUser()` before anything else, re-validates with the same zod
  schemas (bounded: ≤ 500 trials, delay ≤ 20, every number range-checked, unknown keys
  stripped), recomputes server-side and saves through `saveExperiment` with module `"neuro"`;
  `user_id` comes from the `auth.uid()` default and RLS. No secrets or `process.env` in client code.
- Explorer: selection/hover state shared between canvas and keyboard list (`aria-pressed`),
  canvas `role="img"` + `aria-label`, WebGL detection → list-only fallback, error boundary,
  no auto-rotate / pulse / damping and on-demand frame loop under reduced motion.
- Region pages: `generateStaticParams` over the content, `notFound()` on unknown slugs, every
  field and DOI/PubMed links.
- Citations: **all 16 DOIs** (14 unique in `brain-regions.ts` plus Miller et al. 1995 and
  Sutton 1988 in the model cards; Schultz, Dayan & Montague 1997 appears in both) resolved
  through Crossref, and **all 15 PMIDs** resolved through E-utilities. Title, first author, year,
  volume and pages match the code in every case, and each PMID's record lists the same DOI.
  Rescorla & Wagner 1972 is correctly cited as a book chapter without a DOI. Region copy reads as
  measured and associational; no "dopamine simulation" claims.
- `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test` (42 tests) and `pnpm build` green before and after
  the fix.

**Fixed**
- `fix(neuro)`: the simulator wrapped its summaries *and* all charts in `aria-live`, so every
  slider step re-announced chart content to screen readers. The live region now covers only the
  RW and TD summaries.

**Open (not blocking)**
- MEDIUM: on touch devices OrbitControls captures gestures over the 340 px canvas, so the page
  cannot be scrolled by swiping on the canvas itself (the surrounding page still scrolls).
- LOW: the Server Action has no rate limit (each call writes one bounded row, RLS-scoped to the
  caller); a malformed payload returns zod's generic union message.
- LOW: region pages are rendered on demand because the `(app)` layout reads cookies (already
  noted under Deviations).
- Phone-width layout was reviewed from the markup only; the e2e spec was not run (per the rules).
